messages:
mike: quick heads-up — yesterday around 03:20 UTC i noticed a bunch of requests from kv-prefetcher that have child spans in jaeger but no root span (trace id present, root missing). dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/XYz/prefetcher-traces :confused:

lucy: are you seeing this for all traces or a subset? sampler changes in the deploy?

mike: subset — looks like longer jobs with >2s latency. we rolled otel-js 1.10 -> 1.12 last week in canary (eng-runtime deploy). i can paste logs if helpful.

ana: fwiw, parent-based sampling can drop the root if context isn't propagated into the worker. can you paste how workers receive req context?

mike: they use async queue + rabbit. handler enqueues with req.id header -> worker consumes and sets traceparent from header before starting spans. code snippet in worker: ```js
// on message
const ctx = propagation.extract(rootContext, msg.headers, headersGetter);
context.with(ctx, () => tracer.startActiveSpan('worker.process', (span) => { ... }));
```

lucy: that looks fine. what collector exporter + header format are you using? otlp/grpc? jaeger?

mike: OTLP/gRPC to our collector. collector forwards to jaeger/tempo.

raj: a few quick checks: 1) confirm traceparent header name casing (some proxies lowercase). 2) check collector ingest logs for dropped root spans (sampling at collector). 3) verify SDK auto-instrumentation didn't switch to probabilistic sampler.

mike: ran grep on logs, i see entries like `no parent context found` in worker at times. but other times parent is applied. intermittent.

observability-bot: FYI — relevant dashboards/links:
- Trace ingestion metrics: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ingest/trace-ingest
- Collector logs: https://logs.redwood.com/query?service=otel-collector
- Sampling debug guide: https://docs.redwood.com/observability/sampling-debug

ana: also check env vars in the worker process: `OTEL_PROPAGATORS` should include `tracecontext`. if it only has `baggage` you won't get W3C headers.

mike: confirmed worker env: `OTEL_PROPAGATORS=b3` — ah. our http frontends send W3C traceparent but workers expect b3. mismatch explains intermittent loss when proxies convert headers.

lucy: nice find. options: 1) set OTEL_PROPAGATORS=tracecontext,baggage in workers 2) add a header conversion step on enqueue to store both formats 3) make the collector accept both.

raj: for short-term, flip worker to include `tracecontext` and roll canary. also add an alert: high rate of "no parent context found" logs. i can add a one-off metric and alert if you want.

mike: will do a quick canary with `OTEL_PROPAGATORS=tracecontext,b3,baggage` and report back in ~30m. thanks all :thumbsup:

ana: if you still see missing roots after that, capture one full request flow (frontend -> enqueue -> worker) with headers and share. we can trace header transformation path.

mike: ack, updating env now. will post results.

lucy: ping me when canary is up and i'll check jaeger.

observability-bot: note — added runbook link for context propagation checks: https://docs.redwood.com/observability/context-propagation-runbook
